title: ALD_porous-sphere_JV — Diffusion-reaction model for ALD on a porous sphere
description: This Python script provides the solution of the one-dimensional diffusion equation with surface reaction for volumetric reactant number density and surface coverage as function of time along the radial coordinate of a porous sphere (Eq. 1 of Heikkinen et al., Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys., 2024, 26, 7580, DOI: 10.1039/d3cp05639b, for spheres). For the surface reaction, the model uses Langmuir adsorption and includes a desorption term (as in Eq. 16 of Ylilammi et al., J. Appl. Phys. 123, 205301, 2018, DOI: 10.1063/1.5028178). The partial differential equations for diffusion and reaction are solved numerically. For the calculations, the effective diffusion coefficient is assumed to be constant along the porous sphere. This script can be used in a wide range of diffusion regimes (Kn number from Kn<<1 to Kn>>1). The script was written by Dr. Jorge A. Velasco, by request of Prof. Riikka L. Puurunen (Catalysis Group, Aalto University).
